text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Of course. But before that, I presume
that you
have accumulated fatigue
during this long stay
away from home.
choice_data_list: 学園に帰っても頑張ろう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's keep working hard once we're back at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I will show my appreciation
by giving
you a foot massage while we
ride the bus.

choice_data_list: ありがとう、でも大丈夫

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am confident in my abilities. I mastered
the
technique after reading about it in a
magazine
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am also confident in my grip and finger
strength.
Just the other day, I was able
to crush an apple
with one hand.

I tell her it's truly fine and politely
decline again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the bus to depart. I'll
see you
later.

I see Mihono Bourbon off as she gets
onto the
bus.

Rice Shower slowly approaches, covered
in mud.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I did... everything I could... this summer...
I won't
fall behind...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I need to change, and fast!
And so, summer draws to a close.
